gridIndex: cell = iLat * nLon + iLon; cell centre lat = lat0 + iLat * res, lon = lon0 + iLon * res (a GFS 0.25 deg grid point)
notes: Featured rows (featured = 1) come first: the 9 app views in app order, then the new sea-of-clouds places in research-file order (config/new_cafes.json, then config/mountain_candidates.json). Then peaks, then cafes, each by OSM type (node, way, relation) and id. Province: the OSM province (admin_level 4; Metro Manila: the NCR region) holding the place, else Natural Earth admin-1 (public domain); featured rows: researched. Elevation: OSM ele, a cited summit height, or Copernicus GLO-90 (null when unknown). Locality: the town line shown before the province ('Bel-Air, Makati'), from OpenStreetMap; localityBasis 'featured' = researched text, 'admin' = the OSM city/municipality boundary (admin_level 6) holding the place, 'tag' = the place's own address tags, 'near' = the nearest OSM town/village node (show 'Near <locality>'); null when none. Cafes: branch or barangay, then the town.
